entities.name: Das Buddhistische Haus
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Das Buddhistische Haus is a Theravada Buddhist temple complex (Vihara) in Frohnau, Berlin, Germany. It is considered to be the oldest and largest Theravada Buddhist center in Europe and has been declared a National Heritage site.
